workflows.name: VerifyDiveChecksumsWorkflow
workflows.schedule: on-demand only (operator `temporal workflow start`, args dive_id, limit|null)
calls: verify_dive_checksums_activity (s2c 6h, heartbeat 10m, retry 30s x2 backoff, max 5m interval, 5 attempts)

workflows.name: VerifyAllDivesChecksumsWorkflow
calls: select_canonical_dive_ids_activity (only if dive_ids is None; s2c 5m, 3 attempts)
verify_dive_checksums_activity per dive, serially (s2c 6h, hb 10m, 5 attempts); per-dive failure recorded as `error`, sweep continues

workflows.name: BackupDatabasesWorkflow
workflows.schedule: schedule id `fishsense-daily-db-backup` (backup.schedule_id); cron `0 3 * * *` UTC; workflow id `fishsense-daily-db-backup`; no overlap policy set (Temporal default SKIP), no run timeout; input BackupDatabasesInput(databases, nas_root_path, retention_count)
calls: pg_dump_database per DB in parallel (asyncio.gather; s2c 2h, start_to_close 2h, no heartbeat_timeout, default retry)

workflows.name: _dispatch helpers (not a workflow; shared parent steps)
calls: wake_gpu_worker -> ensure_gpu_worker_running_activity (s2c 30m, hb 5m, SCALING) returns gpu|cpu_fallback|unavailable
dispatch_populate (child on api queue, exec 30m, ALLOW_DUPLICATE)

activities.name: stage_raw_bytes_for_dive_activity
activities.purpose: NAS -> Garage raw/{checksum}.ORF for a dive's canonical images; HEAD-skip already staged; semaphore e4e_nas.stage_concurrency (default 1); 408 -> non-retryable NasFileNotFound; returns StageRawBytesResult(staged, skipped_already_present, no_path)

activities.name: stage_slate_pdf_activity
activities.purpose: NAS -> Garage slate_pdf/{slate_id}.pdf; HEAD-skip; raises if slate row/path missing (no 408 classification here)
touches: api: GET dive_slates (fs.dive_slates.get, then filter by id)

activities.name: cleanup_raw_bytes_for_dive_activity
activities.purpose: Delete raw/{checksum}.ORF for ALL of a dive's images (not canonical-filtered) unless a sibling raw-reading child is Running (Temporal visibility query WorkflowId IN (...)); fails closed if Temporal unreachable; concurrency 8

activities.name: ensure_data_worker_running_activity
activities.purpose: Scale per-image (cpu) Deployment to active_replicas (absolute); no-op returning 0 when kubeconfig unset

activities.name: ensure_light_worker_running_activity
activities.purpose: Scale -light Deployment to light_active_replicas; no-op when unconfigured

activities.name: ensure_gpu_worker_running_activity
activities.purpose: Read GPU Deployment (annotations+readiness), run gpu_fallback.decide, set both gpu/cpu-fallback replica counts, patch annotations if state changed, poll readiness every 10s up to gpu_start_timeout_seconds (heartbeating); re-observe on timeout; returns gpu|cpu_fallback|unavailable (gpu when unconfigured)
touches: k8s: get deployment, patch deployments/scale x2, patch deployment metadata.annotations

activities.name: scale_down_data_worker_if_idle_activity
activities.purpose: For each (deployment, queue) in sweep_targets: busy = any workflow on TaskQueue Running or CloseTime > now-idle_cooldown; scale to 0 if idle OR busy-but-wedged; never touches annotations

activities.name: verify_dive_checksums_activity
activities.purpose: Read-only: download whole files (sorted by path, first `limit`), md5 vs stored checksum, EXIF 0x0132 (naive->UTC) vs taken_datetime; 408 = finding (missing_on_nas), other DSM errors propagate; NOT canonical-filtered

activities.name: select_canonical_dive_ids_activity
activities.purpose: Sorted ids of dives having >=1 canonical image

activities.name: reconcile_labeling_configs_activity
activities.purpose: List LS projects in configured workspace; match title suffix (longest first) to LASER/SPECIES/HEADTAIL/DIVE_SLATE config XML; heal_labeling_config each; returns counts scanned/healed/unchanged/unrecognized. No DB access

activities.name: sync_users_label_studio_activity
activities.purpose: LS users -> fishsense user rows (by email; post or put). Called by laser/headtail/species sync parents; v2 deliberately dropped it (labels/workflow.py docstring)
touches: api: GET users by email, POST/PUT users

activities.name: pg_dump_database (backup-worker)
activities.purpose: pg_dump -Fc one DB into its own TemporaryDirectory as {ISO-UTC}.dump, upload to NAS {nas_root_path}/{db}/; heartbeat pump every 30s

activities.name: prune_database_backups (backup-worker)
activities.purpose: List NAS {root}/{db}, delete canonical-named dumps beyond newest `keep` (foreign filenames ignored)

api_endpoints.semantics: All dives that have at least one Image with is_canonical = true (used by the checksum sweep selector)

api_endpoints.route: GET images for a dive (SDK fs.images.get(dive_id=...))
api_endpoints.semantics: All image rows of a dive incl. path, checksum, is_canonical, taken_datetime; staging filters is_canonical client-side, cleanup and verify do not
All slates; stage_slate_pdf filters by id client-side and needs `path` (share-relative NAS path)
Upsert LS identity by email (label_studio_id, names, last_activity, date_joined); not needed in v2 per labels/workflow.py

v2_schema_gaps: No per-dive integer key for Label Studio titles: v1 titles embed `#{int dive_id}` and ensure_project_shows_predictions matches on it; v2 dives.id is uuid and dives.v1_id is NULL for new dives. GPU-fallback state: v1 stores it in annotations on the GPU Deployment; v2's decided stand-up/tear-down (PLAN §4.8) deletes the Deployment, erasing the counter. Needs a home that survives deletion (a small table, or a ConfigMap) -- not present in 0001-0017
slate_templates.id is uuid; v1 scratch key is `slate_pdf/{int slate_id}.pdf`. Key layout must switch to uuid or v1_id (no schema change strictly needed, but contract change)

captures has source_path, raw_object_key, checksum, checksum_algorithm, is_canonical, captured_at -- enough for staging, cleanup and checksum verify (uncertain: whether source_path is stored share-relative like v1 image.path; staging prepends raw_root_path)
No object-key columns for processed JPEGs (derived from checksum + folder in v1); fine if v2 keeps derivation, but PLAN §9.11 wants every NEW key under a tenant prefix -- the layout, not a column
No table for checksum-verification results (v1 returns them only as workflow results); none required for parity
Backup worker needs no schema; but backup.databases must name v2's new database (PLAN §6.1: new DB in same instance) plus superset
Users with label_studio_id (for sync_users) absent in 0002 -- v2 intentionally dropped user sync (labels/workflow.py docstring); listed for completeness

Processor slices must register each workflow/activity in exactly one role (roles.py contract)
gotchas: NAS is read-only from the orchestrator; cleanup deletes only Garage raw/ scratch; a tripwire test asserts the cleanup module imports no NAS client (CLAUDE.md 'Garage object-store key contract')

No inner retry loop around NAS downloads: bounded jittered STAGE_RAW_RETRY_POLICY (2s, x2, max 60s, 5 attempts, NasFileNotFound non-retryable) -- an inner loop caused the 200x storm that tripped the NAS auto-block (krg-infra#501)
TaskGroup wraps failures in ExceptionGroup, hiding non_retryable; staging unwraps and re-raises the leaf ApplicationError (stage_raw_bytes_for_dive_activity.py:203)
Staging concurrency default 1 (FileStation 502s under concurrency); never skip a missing file
FileStation surfaces an unresolved path as 502 not 404: prefix e4e_nas.raw_root_path (/fishsense_data/REEF/data) to share-relative DB paths; absolute paths pass through
Staging and resolvers are canonical-only; cleanup is deliberately NOT canonical-filtered (evicts older scratch); verify is NOT canonical-filtered (duplicates are least-trusted)

Cleanup must skip while any raw-reading sibling child is Running (dive-442 incident, 2026-09-07); fails CLOSED if Temporal unreachable; every new raw-reading child id must be added to raw_scratch_reader_ids; exact WorkflowId IN, never prefix match (dive 44 vs 442)
dispatch_child returns CHILD_ALREADY_RUNNING on WorkflowAlreadyStartedError; caller must then skip cleanup and flag clearing
Child ids deterministic + ALLOW_DUPLICATE (not FAILED_ONLY) for both processor and populate children (prod dives 59/439/60)
_dispatch/_populate emit the same command sequence as the inlined code -- replay contract; per-stage timeouts are parameters (slate PDF 5m vs 15m)

Scaling is off unless kubernetes.kubeconfig_path set; then namespace required; replicas always ABSOLUTE; active/light/gpu replicas clamped [1,4], fallback [1,2], max_start_failures >=1, wedge_grace clamped <= gpu_start_timeout
Parents only scale up; only the +55 sweeper scales down; sweeper writes only deployments/scale, never GPU annotations (else a long outage resets its own counter)
Sweeper scales a busy-but-wedged Deployment (spec.replicas>0, readyReplicas absent) to 0 -- k8s omits readyReplicas, treat None as 0 (2026-08-14 GPUs pinned by expired cert)
A Deployment missing from sweep_targets is never scaled down -- add every role there
On 'unavailable' the predict parents must return BEFORE staging; dispatching onto an unserved queue hangs until execution timeout
GPU fallback window expires (default 180m) so NRP trouble can't strand predict on CPU; naive annotation timestamps read as UTC; malformed annotations degrade to defaults
Python 3.13 VERIFY_X509_STRICT rejects NRP apiserver cert (no AKI): clear only that flag, keep CERT_REQUIRED (k8s_scaling.py:260)
Build k8s Configuration explicitly (no global default mutation); kubernetes import lazy
gpu_active_replicas separate from active_replicas: a 2nd GPU pod sat Pending on Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu (2026-08-20)
Per-image (cpu) role max_concurrent_activities=2 is a memory ceiling (OOM at 4, 17 restarts 2026-07-21); light role cap 8; gpu-cpu-fallback cap 1; memory limits derived from cap
Light queue exists because sub-second jobs expired with ScheduleToStart behind 2-slot per-image dispatch (2026-09-04)
roles.py: every activity/workflow in exactly one role list; `all` role runs every queue for local dev; role vocabulary in leaf role_names.py to avoid config->roles->activities->config import cycle
GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT 30s; terminationGracePeriodSeconds 45 must be >= it
Data-worker has no NAS access and no k8s token (automountServiceAccountToken false)

v2 decided stand-up/tear-down (PLAN §4.8): NRP GC's Deployments >2 weeks old; v1's were apply'd once and scaled, and got deleted ~09-21 (5 days of stages silently didn't run). v2 needs create/delete on deployments, not just scale, and wedge check must tolerate a missing Deployment

nrp_cert_sync (deploy/incus/nrp_cert_sync/sync.sh:44) rollout-restarts all four Deployments and skips missing ones; with tear-down, only the Secret update matters (a new Deployment mounts the current leaf). 7-day leaf; expired NRP cert caused the 2026-08-14 outage

ensure_schedule never updates in place (delete + redeploy); v2 inherits (orchestrator/schedules.py); PLAN §4.5 calls it a footgun to fix; retired schedules must be actively deleted at startup (_RETIRED_SCHEDULE_IDS)
Selector schedules use overlap SKIP; LS sync schedules ALLOW_ALL with 3h run timeout
LS 429 is not a missing project: back off per `Expected available in N seconds` +2s (default 30s), max 5 attempts, then raise (project 274633 silently skipped)

Hosted LS import is async: never re-import on invisible tasks; dedup by URL against project and batch; decode `fileuri=` base64 resolve-wrapper URLs; IMPORT_ISSUED heartbeat marker (every later heartbeat must carry it); publish only when ImportResult.deferred == 0
Label config drift compared structurally (LS reformats XML); LS rejection of a config change is logged and swallowed
Workspace name configured but not found -> raise (never scatter projects into default workspace)
LS project titles <= 50 chars, `#{dive_id}` tail never truncated; dive names are not unique
ensure_project_shows_predictions: most-populated tag wins, ties to current; only per-dive projects (#{dive_id} in title); never raises
label_studio.bot_user_id stamps completed_by on imported annotations (0 = omit field), populate_laser_label_studio_project_activity.py:174

verify_dive_checksums_activity heartbeats the index but never reads heartbeat_details, so despite its docstring a retry re-downloads from the start (uncertain intent; the workflow docstring claims resume)
Checksum convention: md5 of whole file, 8192-byte chunks; taken_datetime = naive EXIF 0x0132 stamped UTC, camera offset NOT applied (verified on 1,619 frames/272 dives 2026-08-17)

BackupDatabasesWorkflow uses asyncio.gather without return_exceptions: one failed dump fails the workflow and skips ALL pruning, contradicting its docstring's 'independent' claim; the pg_dump/prune activities heartbeat but the workflow sets no heartbeat_timeout (pump is inert)
pg_dump per activity in its own TemporaryDirectory (2026-05-03 collision incident); password via PGPASSWORD env, never argv; -Fc; prune ignores non-canonical filenames
Backup target is the NAS, which v2 retires (PLAN §9.5/§9.15): must not move onto the same single-node Garage
Dynaconf validates ALL validators on first settings access; worker object_store imports config function-locally (v2 uses pydantic-settings, less relevant)
E4EFS_DOCKER truthiness must be an explicit truthy string ('false' must not mean Docker)
url_condition not validators.url (docker hostnames without TLD)
Object-store _exists maps only 404/NoSuchKey/NotFound to False; other errors propagate; _get must close StreamingBody (connection-pool leak)
boto3 path-style addressing required for Garage
